observations: The page number «( 16 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

L01-L15: the division of 46468 by 324 concluded (pp. 14-15, frames 020-021). The divisor is moved under 1108, the remainder of the second round: four under eight, two under the circle, three under one. The quotient figure three: three by three, nine, from eleven leaves two; three by two, six, from twenty leaves fourteen; three by four, twelve, from «cxxviii.», printed for 148 (see the critical note), leaves six above the four, three above the two and one above the three, 136. The result: «.cxliii.», 143, and «cxxxvi. partes de .ccc.xxiiii. partibus unius», 136 parts of 324 parts of one: 46468 = 324 × 143 + 136. L14-L15 «et hec figura eorum.»: the figure is not printed.

L16-L33: the second example, a number of several places divided by one place: «mille .dccc.», 1800, by «.ix.», 9: two circles, then eight and one; nine under eight; the quotient figure two, nine by two, eighteen, nothing remains; nine moved under the circle, a circle above it in the quotient; nine moved again to the first place, under a circle. The page ends in the course of the example.

L16: the vertical bar at the beginning of the paragraph marks the beginning of fol. 107 verso of the manuscript, which the note in the left margin, «car. 107 verso.», names; transcribed as a margin note.
L23: «quos multiplicabis .ix. ix.»: the numeral nine is printed twice, the second time without its opening point; see the critical note.

L14: «cxxxvi.partes» and «.ccc.xxiiii.» are printed without a space after the point. «unius:» is a colon; a dark wedge-shaped speck, 6 by 12 px, stands below the base line 8 px to the left of its lower dot, not joined to it; not transcribed.

L21: «consumet quod», the two words 10 px apart, where the other word spaces of the line are 12 to 14 px; transcribed with a space. L26: the bowl of the q of «quod» is broken, only its upper part printed beside the stem.
L32: «eos (sic)»: the edition marks the form with «(sic)» in italics.

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): with a space before the mark, L08 «.xx. ,» (22 px), L10 «xii. ;» (23 px), L13 «.cxliii. ,» (22 px), L18 «circulos :» (10 px), L20 «.viii. :» (13 px), L22 «se ,» (16 px) and L24 «remanebit :» (21 px); without a space after the mark, L21 «quid,quod» (6 px) and «.ix.,consumet» (9 px, the median word space of the line 14 px) and L31 «.ix.sub» (11 px, median 17 px). L03 «uno: postea» (12 px) has a space. Specks after the comma of L18 «est,» and after the point of L03 «iiii.», and pencil marks at L04 «tres,», L05 «tribus,» and L14 «unius:», shorten the measured gaps; the spaces there are read on the scan.
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: L07, «quoque» underlined; L08, «vi.» underlined; «super» in the left margin beside L12, with «supra» underlined; «quod» beside L14, with «et» underlined, and a hook below the colon of «unius:»; «duo» beside L18, with «duos» underlined; «inueniensque» beside L22, with «ni» of «inueniesque» marked; «quia» beside L27, with «quare» underlined; L33, an accent over the «e» of «ibidem». Not part of the edition.

critical_notes.evidence: after the second figure of the quotient the places above the divisor hold one, four and eight: fourteen, the remainder of twenty less six (L08-L09), and the eight of 1108 (L02); three by four, twelve, taken from them leaves «sex … tres … unum», 136 (L12), which is 148 less 12, where 128 less 12 is 116
critical_notes.impact: the intermediate number reads 148; the remainder 136 and the result 143 and 136/324 are right

critical_notes.evidence: the numeral nine is printed twice, the second time without its opening point, in «quos multiplicabis .ix. ix. et erunt .xviii.», multiply them (the two) by nine and they are eighteen; the sense and the parallel «quod cum multiplicaueris in .ix.» (L21) need it once
